notes.title: Ver1.24 Update
notes.content:
The GGC Cup Strange Mahjong has concluded
No.20 Score Attack mode has been added
An in-game ranking system has been implemented
Time continues to be measured even when the options menu is opened during Time Attack
The title for No.5 Strange has been changed
Routes for No.14 and No.16 have been added

notes.title: Ver1.23 Update
notes.content:
・Fixed an issue where the UI would break when set to other languages
・Corrected some translations

notes.title: Ver1.22 Update
notes.content: ・Added a "Retry" function to "Final Time Attack."

notes.title: Ver1.21 Update
notes.content:
・When failing in 'Final Time Attack' and returning to the first east round, the timer will now reset.
・Added an announcement for the GGC Cup.

notes.title: Ver1.20 Update
notes.content:
・Added Time Attack mode
・Supports Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, and English (may have deficiencies)

notes.title: Ver1.19 Update
notes.content:
・We have added a title screen.
・We have made it so that the sound doesn't stop when the game is inactive.

notes.title: Ver1.18 Update
notes.content: ・Added Incident No. 36 and No. 37.

notes.title: Ver1.17 Update
notes.content:
・Adjusted the lighting.
・Fixed a bug where "No. 26" could not properly "Chi" (perform the "Chi" action).
・Added anomaly No. 35.

notes.title: Ver1.16 Update
notes.content:
・Adjusted the lighting.
・Added anomaly No.34.

notes.title: Ver1.15 Update
notes.content:
・Implemented tutorial display.
・Adjusted No.10 so that anomalies appear earlier.
・Adjusted No.10 so that the round ends immediately after a call-out.
・Fixed an issue where the tiles to be called (Chi) were difficult to see in No.11.
・Adjusted the winning rate of COM in No.12.
・Adjusted the winning rate of COM in No.27.

notes.title: Ver1.14 Update
notes.content: ・The event No. 33 has been added

notes.title: Ver1.13 Update
notes.content:
・Added a replay button as there were instances where the Mahjong rules video would stop.
・Adjusted the winning rate of Player No. 11.
・Adjusted the winning rate of Player No. 12.
・Increased the tile discard speed for Player No. 17.
・Fixed a bug where Player No. 26 could not perform a "Chi" properly.
・Changed the game to end at the point of a specified warning for Player No. 31.
・Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: Ver1.12 Update
notes.content:
・Stations without abnormalities are now adjusted to end faster.
・Adjusted the win rate for Player No. 20.
・The game now ends at the point of being pointed out for No. 32.

notes.title: Ver1.11 Update
notes.content:
・Modified the wording of the "Ihen Mahjong" rules.
・Implemented a hint feature for No. 17.
・For No. 18 and No. 19, opponents are now more likely to discard tiles that cause them to lose against the player.

notes.title: Ver1.10 Update
notes.content: Fixed a bug where tiles could not be clicked under certain conditions.

notes.title: Ver1.09 Update
notes.content:
・Adjusted the anomaly selection algorithm for the first playthrough.
・Greatly extended the time limit for No.2.
・Further extended the grace period for pointing out No.7.
・Weakened the AI for No.11.
・Further extended the grace period for pointing out No.21.
・Improved the visibility of discarded tiles and exposed tiles for No.23.
・Changed the anomaly title for No.24.
・Added an effect immediately after the anomaly occurs for No.30.
・Made the anomaly more noticeable toward the end of the round for No.31.

notes.title: Ver1.08 Update
notes.content: Adjustments have been made so that when the conditions for progressing No.14 and No.16 can no longer be met, the event will occur again.

notes.title: Ver1.07 Update
notes.content:
・No1: Implemented a mechanism to improve the accuracy rate.
・No5: Fixed an issue where failing to win after pointing out an anomaly would result in failure.
・No22: The game now ends when an anomaly is pointed out.
・No28: Extended the event duration.
・Fixed a bug where selecting an anomaly from the Dictionary could cause options and the Dictionary to not appear in the next anomaly.

notes.title: Ver1.06 Update
notes.content:
・Changed the explanation of the Ihen Mahjong rules to a video.
・Updated the wording of the progress conditions.
・Adjusted the presentation of No.14.

notes.title: Ver1.05 Update
notes.content:
・The rules for "Ihen Mahjong" have been revised.
・The conditions for progression have been clarified.
・The progression conditions are now always displayed.
・No.16: The behavior of the hand during cutscenes has been changed.
・No.18, 19, 20: The round now progresses when the conditions for progression are met.
・Fixed a bug where selecting a different "Ihen" from the dictionary could cause the selected "Ihen" to fail.

notes.title: Ver1.04 Update
notes.content:
・We have adjusted the display time for progress conditions to extend according to the amount of text.
・We have extended the grace period for No. 7.
・For No. 17, the game will end as soon as an incorrect answer is given.
・We have extended the grace period for No. 21.
・For No. 25, the game will end as soon as the issue is pointed out.
・For No. 26, the game will end as soon as the issue is pointed out.
・For No. 30, the game will end as soon as the issue is pointed out.

notes.title: Ver1.03 Update
notes.content:
Corrected the parts of the Ihen Mahjong rules that differed from the actual game rules.
Now displays the necessary knowledge when Ihen Detection Assist is enabled.

notes.title: Ver1.02 Update
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the action button was difficult to press while using the anomaly detection assist function.

notes.title: Ver1.01 Update
notes.content:
・Clarification of progression conditions to the extent that it does not impair the gaming experience
・An assist option for detecting anomalies
・Fixed an unintended progression for anomaly No. 28
